critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage is complete with visible focus across the header and atlas; touch-target violations are zero; reduced-motion testing shows no changed elements; and no uncontained viewport overflow or automated WCAG violations were found. However, contrast remains unproven: axe marked color contrast serious/incomplete for 35–74 atlas nodes and 14–26 header nodes because gradient/overlap prevented measurement. Tablet/mobile also clip large horizontal navigation and atlas regions, with up to 96 overflow candidates; keyboard reachability does not prove usable touch or focus-scroll behavior for this content.
critique.fix: Use deterministic solid backgrounds or testable overlays, then measure and remediate every text/control contrast ratio to WCAG AA. Re-test the header, React Flow nodes, filters, labels, cards, and hints. Add clearly operable horizontal-scroll controls/position feedback and verify that touch, keyboard focus, and screen-reader navigation expose every clipped stage and header destination.
